finalText:
CHANGELOG.md updated, 4.2.0 section added.

764 commits / 128 PRs, most noise (dep bumps, refactors, renames, test churn). Real signal: 1 status-code break (auth 401 vs 403), 1 new capability (webhook retry backoff), 10 distinct fixed-bug classes hitting real endpoints (null-cursor crash, double-slash routing, empty-allowlist crash, duplicate header, trace-id loss on retry, wrong histogram units, vague token-parser error, leaked timer, unclosed pool, request body logged raw — privacy issue worth flagging to security folks too).

Note: many titles repeat across modules (queue/api/webhooks/db etc) — same bug class, separate fix per subsystem, not duplicates. Trace-id fix shows 3 separate commits (05-22, 06-01, 06-13) — likely regressed and refixed; only final state noted.

Skipped: perf commits (JSON round-trip skip, metric batching, clone avoidance, schema reuse) — real but internal/invisible to users, no user-facing latency numbers in the log to cite. Say if you want a Performance line added anyway.
